Staff Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI): GBEE-R2 Source: web page The purpose of this regulation is to protect staff, student, parent and 27J information and to direct staff on information that cannot be submitted to artificial intelligence applications/programs. For the purpose of this policy AI applications/programs includes Chat GPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Apple AI, and other similar programs or applications. 27J employees and contractors shall not submit, store, or process in AI systems or tools the following: (1) personally identifiable information (PII); (2) protected health information (PHI); (3) District intellectual property; (4) District and school safety plans, information and protocols. Schools should fully understand who has legal authority and control over the data that is entered into the system, what uses are permitted, vendor obligations, and third-party data sharing practices. Administrators must understand what liability they may or may not be taking on, and what happens if there is misuse, inaccuracies, or data breaches. All student data is sensitive, and AI systems must comply with all applicable federal and state laws protecting that data. Do not share any PII, including name, birth date, address, phone number, social security number, or other financial or confidential information. Choose Trustworthy AI Tools We carefully select AI tools that protect our students' privacy.
